# Overview

```{r}
# Build plots
construct_rel_bias_plot = function(rel_bias_data,n_val_to_exclude = 1000,
                                   include_title = TRUE)
{
  if (include_title == TRUE)
  {
    title_name = "SRS Relative Bias Results"
  }
  else
  {
      title_name = ""
  }
  rel_bias_plot = rel_bias_data %>%
    filter(estimator != "RF", n_size != n_val_to_exclude, pred !=75) %>%
    mutate(n_size = factor(n_size), rho = as.numeric(rho)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = rho, y = rel_bias, color=estimator)) +
    facet_grid( vars(pred), vars( model), scales = "free_y", labeller = plot_labeller_mser) +
    geom_line(aes(linetype = n_size), size = 1) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = estimator)) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title=title_name,
       x = bquote(rho), y = "Relative Bias") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, face = "bold", size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=12),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size =15),
        title = element_text(size=18),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.position = "top") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0.1,0.3,0.5,0.7)) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(title="Estimator"),
         shape = guide_legend(title = "Estimator"),
         linetype = guide_legend(title = "n")) 
  return(rel_bias_plot)
}
# Build the MSE plot
construct_mse_plot = function(mse_data, n_val_to_exclude = 1000,
                                   include_title = TRUE,
                              exclude_estimators = c("RF"))
{
  if (include_title == TRUE)
  {
    title_name = "SRS MSE Results"
  }
  else
  {
      title_name = ""
  }
  mse_plot = mse_data %>%
    filter(estimator %!in% exclude_estimators, n_size != n_val_to_exclude, pred !=75) %>%
    mutate(n_size = factor(n_size), rho = as.numeric(rho)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = rho, y = mse, color=estimator)) +
    facet_grid( vars(pred), vars( model), scales = "free_y", labeller = plot_labeller_mser) +
    geom_line(aes(linetype = n_size), size = 1) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = estimator)) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title=title_name,
       x = bquote(rho), y = "MSE") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, face = "bold", size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=12),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size =15),
        title = element_text(size=18),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.position = "top") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0.1,0.3,0.5,0.7)) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(title="Estimator"),
         shape = guide_legend(title = "Estimator"),
         linetype = guide_legend(title = "n")) 
  return(mse_plot)
}

# Build the MSE plot
construct_mse_plot_free_axes = function(mse_data, n_val_to_exclude = 1000,
                                   include_title = TRUE,
                              exclude_estimators = c("RF"))
{
  if (include_title == TRUE)
  {
    title_name = "SRS MSE Results"
  }
  else
  {
      title_name = ""
  }
  mse_plot = mse_data %>%
    filter(estimator %!in% exclude_estimators, n_size != n_val_to_exclude, pred !=75) %>%
    mutate(n_size = factor(n_size), rho = as.numeric(rho)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = rho, y = mse, color=estimator)) +
    facet_grid2( vars(pred), vars( model), scales = "free_y", labeller = plot_labeller_mser,
                  independent = "y") +
    geom_line(aes(linetype = n_size), size = 1) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = estimator)) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title=title_name,
       x = bquote(rho), y = "MSE") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, face = "bold", size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=12),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size =15),
        title = element_text(size=18),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.position = "top") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0.1,0.3,0.5,0.7)) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(title="Estimator"),
         shape = guide_legend(title = "Estimator"),
         linetype = guide_legend(title = "n")) 
  return(mse_plot)
}
# MSE Plot with n on the axes
construct_mse_plot_free_axes_alt = function(mse_data, n_val_to_exclude = 1000,
                                   include_title = TRUE,
                              exclude_estimators = c("RF"))
{
  if (include_title == TRUE)
  {
    title_name = "SRS MSE Results"
  }
  else
  {
      title_name = ""
  }
  mse_plot = mse_data %>%
    filter(estimator %!in% exclude_estimators, n_size != n_val_to_exclude, pred !=75) %>%
    mutate(rho = factor(rho)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = n_size, y = mse, color=estimator)) +
    facet_grid2( vars(pred), vars( model), scales = "free_y", labeller = plot_labeller_mser,
                  independent = "y") +
    geom_line(aes(linetype = rho), size = 1) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = estimator)) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title=title_name,
       x = "n", y = "MSE") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, face = "bold", size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=12),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size =15),
        title = element_text(size=18),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.position = "top") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(250, 500)) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(title="Estimator"),
         shape = guide_legend(title = "Estimator"),
         linetype = guide_legend(title = bquote(rho))) 
  return(mse_plot)
}
```

```{r}
# Make a labeller for plots
predictor_labeller = function(size_string)
{
  return(paste0("p=",size_string))
}
rho_labeller = function(rho_string)
{
  return(paste0("rho==",rho_string))
}

model_labeller = function(model_string)
{
  return(model_string)
}

plot_labeller_mser = labeller(rho = as_labeller(rho_labeller, label_parsed), pred = predictor_labeller, Model = model_labeller)
```

These plots are for the relative biases and MSEs for the SRS plots.

```{r}
# Load in the data
data_locations = c(paste0(here::here(), 
                          "/Data/SRS-Model-1-Dim/Rel-Bias/relative-bias-model-1.csv"),
                   paste0(here::here(), 
                          "/Data/SRS-Model-2-Dim/Rel-Bias/relative-bias-model-2.csv"),
                   paste0(here::here(), 
                          "/Data/SRS-Model-3-Static-Dim/Rel-Bias/relative-bias-model-3.csv"),
                   paste0(here::here(), 
                          "/Data/SRS-Model-4-Dim/Rel-Bias/relative-bias-model-4.csv"))


model_1_bias_mse = read_csv(data_locations[1],lazy = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(model = "Model 1", rho = as.character(rho))

model_2_bias_mse = read_csv(data_locations[2],lazy = TRUE)%>%
  mutate(model = "Model 2", rho = as.character(rho))

model_3_bias_mse = read_csv(data_locations[3],lazy = TRUE)%>%
  mutate(model = "Model 3", rho = as.character(rho))

model_4_bias_mse = read_csv(data_locations[4],lazy = TRUE)%>%
  mutate(model = "Model 4", rho = as.character(rho))

# Organize the data
srs_models_bias_mse = bind_rows(list(model_1_bias_mse,
                                 model_2_bias_mse,
                                 model_3_bias_mse,
                                 model_4_bias_mse)) %>%
  mutate(rho = case_when( rho == "rho_0.1" ~ "0.1",
                          rho == "rho_0.3" ~ "0.3",
                          rho == "rho_0.5" ~ "0.5",
                          rho == "rho_0.7" ~ "0.7",
                          .default = as.character(rho)),
         model = case_when(model == "Model 2" ~ "Model 4",
                           model == "Model 3" ~ "Model 2",
                           model == "Model 4" ~ "Model 3",
                           .default = model))
```

# Plots

## Relative Bias

```{r fig.height=16, fig.width=12}
construct_rel_bias_plot(srs_models_bias_mse )
```

We can observe that all of the relative biases are low for the included estimators.

## MSE Results

MSE results with y-axis free per row.

```{r fig.height=16, fig.width=12}
construct_mse_plot(srs_models_bias_mse )
```

MSE results with separate axes:


```{r fig.height=16, fig.width=12}
construct_mse_plot_free_axes(srs_models_bias_mse)
```

Separate y-axes and HT estimator is excluded:

```{r fig.height=16, fig.width=12}
construct_mse_plot_free_axes(srs_models_bias_mse, exclude_estimators = c("RF", "HT"))
```

We do see consistency in the estimators, particularly the LASSO (MSE decreases as $n$ increases).

Plot with $n$ on the x-axis:

```{r fig.height=16, fig.width=12}
construct_mse_plot_free_axes_alt(srs_models_bias_mse)
```
